records.context: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a microplate sample position can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path (item 752) adds ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, asked for by name and run after those four; a run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its microplate sample positions from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each microplate sample position's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the microplate sample positions run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``.

records.source: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a well can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path (item 752) adds ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, asked for by name and run after those four; a run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its wells from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each well's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the wells run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``.
records.translation: n’importe lesquelles de ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` et ``"decode"``, exécutées dans cet ordre. Une phase omise lit ce dont elle a besoin dans la base de données, de sorte qu’un puits peut être assemblé une fois puis décodé de nouveau. Le parcours phénotype alpha (élément 752) ajoute ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` et ``"aggregate"``, demandées par leur nom et exécutées après ces quatre ; une exécution limitée à celles-ci nécessite ``dst_root`` et ``plate`` mais aucun ``genotype_source``, prend ses puits dans ``ops_phenotype`` et complète le ``ops_report.json`` de chaque puits au lieu de le remplacer. ``aggregate`` regroupe les puits traités et écrit ``ops_guides_<plate>`` et ``ops_genes_<plate>``.

records.context: ``"percentile"`` takes spots above ``percentile`` in a channel; ``"median"`` takes spots where the channel is the argmax. Percentile is the more robust of the two when one base is rare, which is the case a median call gets wrong. ``"argmax_median"`` is brieflow's ``transform_medians``: each channel is first divided by its median over the spots, each channel's axis is the MEDIAN of the spots where it is the argmax, and the axes are scaled to sum to one rather than to unit length, which keeps the corrected channels on the scale the argmax compares. On 116 microscope fields of view of the Funk et al. 2022 laboratory microplates, after the per-cycle normalisation, it raised the library-exact read rate from 0.558 to 0.574 and lowered the decoy match rate.

records.source: ``"percentile"`` takes spots above ``percentile`` in a channel; ``"median"`` takes spots where the channel is the argmax. Percentile is the more robust of the two when one base is rare, which is the case a median call gets wrong. ``"argmax_median"`` is brieflow's ``transform_medians``: each channel is first divided by its median over the spots, each channel's axis is the MEDIAN of the spots where it is the argmax, and the axes are scaled to sum to one rather than to unit length, which keeps the corrected channels on the scale the argmax compares. On 116 fields of the Funk et al. 2022 plates, after the per-cycle normalisation, it raised the library-exact read rate from 0.558 to 0.574 and lowered the decoy match rate.
records.translation: ``"percentile"`` prend les spots au-dessus de ``percentile`` dans un canal ; ``"median"`` prend les spots où le canal est l’argmax. Le percentile est le plus robuste des deux lorsqu’une base est rare, cas que l’appel par la médiane traite mal. ``"argmax_median"`` est le ``transform_medians`` de brieflow : chaque canal est d’abord divisé par sa médiane sur les spots, l’axe de chaque canal est la MÉDIANE des spots où il est l’argmax, et les axes sont mis à l’échelle pour que leur somme vaille un plutôt que pour avoir une longueur unitaire, ce qui garde les canaux corrigés sur l’échelle que compare l’argmax. Sur 116 champs des plaques de Funk et al. 2022, après la normalisation par cycle, il a fait passer le taux de lectures exactes de la bibliothèque de 0,558 à 0,574 et abaissé le taux de correspondances leurres.
